additional_info.subject: Urgent Case Opening: Charger Disconnected from Backend (S/N 170003088)
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Technical Support Team,
We are requesting to open a new support case for one of our charging units that is currently non-operational.
Charger Details:
• Serial Number (S/N): 170003088
• Current Issue: The charger is not functioning properly and is currently disconnected from our backend system.
Previous Case History:
Please note that this unit has experienced issues in the past, and its prior support request was filed under Case ID 448301. We believe referencing this history may assist in your investigation.
Kindly advise on the next steps required to diagnose and resolve this connectivity issue.
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
Get
Outlook for iOS
